applies_why: The judge text resolves the Acts 2:30 collision by comparing the two sides' chains and declaring neither forces the other, rather than demanding a single contrary verse.
rule_words: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires
why: It treats the issue as a chain-against-chain standoff, which is what K-C requires, and does not apply the retired stating-verse test.
